name: MacTFPS
description: Uncaps FPS, boosts TPS, and bypasses V-Sync on Apple Silicon Macs.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: Target frame rate. Set 0 for unlimited.

disable-vsync.name: Disable V-Sync
disable-vsync.description: Force-disables V-Sync. On Apple Silicon bypasses OS-level display sync.

vsync-persistent.name: Keep V-Sync Disabled
vsync-persistent.description: Re-applies V-Sync bypass every frame (macOS only).

show-fps-counter.name: Show FPS Counter
show-fps-counter.description: Display a real-time FPS counter on screen.
